description: Send an email to a lead, a person (contact_id) or an organisation (account_id) — or to any address. Required: subject, body, and lead_id, contact_id, account_id or to_address (to_address defaults to the record's e-mail). Sender: from_email picks one of the tenant's connected mailboxes (own SMTP server, Microsoft or Google); as_me=true sends with your name and sets Reply-To to your address so answers reach you; or set reply_to. If the tenant has switched off external providers (mail_only_own_server), the mail is only sent through an own mailbox. The mail appears in the person's/lead's history. Optional: campaign_id, bcc. Creates a draft and sends it via the existing email pipeline. SENDS FOR REAL to the lead — use send_draft_email first if a human needs to approve. Optional: attachments — document_ids of files already stored (upload_document / create_document_upload_url, or a campaign document). They travel as an expiring download link appended to the mail, and an unknown or foreign document_id ABORTS the send rather than quietly dropping the attachment: a mail whose text points at an enclosure that never came is worse than no mail. Optional: attachment_mode — 'link' (default: an expiring download link is appended to the mail; no size limit, and you can see who downloaded) or 'file' (the file really travels as an attachment; capped at 20 MB in total, because above that receiving servers start refusing the mail). For a brochure the link is usually better, for an invoice or a signed document it is the wrong form.

as_me.description: Your name as sender name, Reply-To your login address.

bcc.description: Extra blind-copy recipients for THIS send — array or comma-separated string. ADDS TO the campaign's bcc_emails, it does not replace them; set the campaign field for a copy that cannot be forgotten. Invalid addresses are dropped and logged, they never block the send.

from_email.description: Address of a connected mailbox to send from.

purpose.description: The processing purpose of THIS mail (e.g. akquise, newsletter, bestandskunde, rechnung). A consent is always for ONE purpose: whoever agreed to the newsletter did not agree to cold outreach, so without a purpose the check can only look at the record's state and at withdrawals. Falls back to the campaign's processing_purpose. If the tenant has switched on legal_basis_enforced, a mail without any purpose is refused.

name: send_email
